request.message:
Update this standing weekly production digest to Week 18. This is the same document every week - edit it in place. Make exactly the changes below and nothing else. STEP 1 - STATUS LINE. The bold status line directly under the document title must read exactly: Week 18 · 2026-05-04 to 2026-05-10 · Phase: Alpha Leave the smaller grey line beneath it unchanged. STEP 2 - ARCHIVE. The 'Archive' table's data rows must end up being EXACTLY these 8 rows, in exactly this order, top to bottom. Keep the table's header row and all of its formatting. Cells shown in quotes are literal - copy them exactly. Cells shown in angle brackets are for you to write. The rows, top to bottom, must be exactly: 'Week 17', 'Week 16', 'Week 15', 'Week 14', 'Week 13', 'Weeks 9-12 (rolled up)', 'Weeks 5-8 (rolled up)', 'Weeks 1-4 (rolled up)'. The first cell of each of those rows must read exactly as quoted, INCLUDING the word 'Week' - write 'Week 3', never '3'. The column is headed 'Week'; that heading is not a substitute for the label. Row 'Week 17' is NEW. Its Dates cell is '2026-04-27 to 2026-05-03'. Its Shipped cell is your own summary, at most 20 words, of EXACTLY this text and nothing else in the document: "Save/load system passes the 500-cycle soak test; Boss encounter 'The Cartographer' first playable". Its Risks carried cell is your own summary, at most 15 words, of exactly these risks: "Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCU; Localisation vendor has no gaming glossary; Save-game format still unversioned". Summarise the quoted text only - other steps in this instruction change the document, and this row must describe Week 17, not the week replacing it. Row 'Weeks 9-12 (rolled up)' is NEW and REPLACES the rows 'Week 12', 'Week 11', 'Week 10', 'Week 9'. Its Dates cell is '2026-03-02 to 2026-03-29'. Its Shipped cell is one sentence of at most 25 words summarising those 4 rows together. Its Risks carried cell is at most 10 words. Delete those rows. Every other row keeps its existing cell contents exactly as they are - do not rewrite, reword or re-summarise them. STEP 3 - 'What changed'. Replace the ENTIRE
    element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
    • Analytics events wired for the first-hour funnel
    • Crash rate down to 0.9% of sessions from 4.2%
    • Photo mode shipped to the internal branch
    • Accessibility pass one: remappable controls, colourblind palettes
    STEP 4 - 'What is at risk' table. Replace the ENTIRE contents of that table's with exactly these 3 rows, character for character. Keep the header row exactly as it is: Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCUYuki T.BackendHighimprovingSecond combat designer starts lateMarcus O.ProductionMediumsteadyCrash rate above the cert thresholdDev H.QAMediumsteady (Context only, do not put this in the document: risks closed this week and therefore absent from the rows above: Localisation vendor has no gaming glossary; Save-game format still unversioned.) STEP 5 - 'What is next'. Replace the ENTIRE
      element in that section with exactly this HTML, character for character:
      • Alpha feature freeze review on Thursday
      • Drive crash rate below 0.5%
      • Finish the accessibility pass two
      REPLACEMENT MEANS REPLACEMENT: where this instruction lists what a section must contain, the section must end up containing exactly that and nothing else. Delete what is not on the list rather than keeping it alongside. Preserve all existing formatting exactly: the document title, every section heading, table borders, header-row shading, alternating row colours, fonts, font sizes and colours. Do not restyle anything. Do not add, remove or rename any heading. Do not reorder the sections. Copy every quoted or listed value character for character. Do not add a full stop to a bullet that has none, and do not reword anything. STRUCTURAL RULE: both tables must remain elements with their header rows intact. Never replace a table with a single row, a div or a list. Never drop a table's header row.

Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest

Week 17 · 2026-04-27 to 2026-05-03 · Phase: Alpha
Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

What changed

  • Save/load system passes the 500-cycle soak test
  • Boss encounter 'The Cartographer' first playable

What is at risk

RiskOwnerArea SeverityTrend
Matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCUYuki T.BackendCriticalworsening
Localisation vendor has no gaming glossarySana R.LocalisationMediumsteady
Save-game format still unversionedDev H.EngineeringLowsteady

What is next

  • Finish the accessibility pass two
  • Lock the weapon archetype list
  • Alpha feature freeze review on Thursday

Archive

Newest first. Detail rows older than 8 weeks are folded into a single rolled-up row so this section stays readable at 52 weeks.

Week Dates Shipped Risks carried
Week 16 2026-04-20 to 2026-04-26 Console TRC dry run completed; weapon balance pass covered all 9 archetypes. Matchmaking backend, localisation vendor, patch size, and save-game versioning remain open.
Week 15 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-19 Crash rate down to 0.9%; photo mode internal branch; accessibility pass one; console TRC dry run completed; Publisher marketing, matchmaking, and localisation risks remained open. Crash rate down to 0.9%; photo mode internal branch; accessibility pass one; console TRC dry run completed; Publisher marketing, matchmaking, and localisation risks remained open.
Week 14 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-12 Enemy AI flocking landed for Scrapper swarms; first eight-player playtest ran 41 minutes; audio middleware spike finished; Wwise beat FMOD Crash rate above cert threshold; publisher marketing beats misaligned; matchmaking backend untested above 5k CCU
Week 13 2026-03-30 to 2026-04-05 Localisation stubbed for 6 languages; vertical slice greyboxed and playable; combat merged; Scrapper swarms gained flocking AI Crash rate above threshold; marketing beats misaligned with content lock; matchmaking untested above 5k CCU
Week 12 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-29 Audio spike finished; Wwise selected; grapple cooldown retuned; camera rig handed off; localisation stubbed Crash rate above threshold; publisher marketing beats misaligned; matchmaking backend untested
Week 11 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-22 Combat prototype merged; Enemy AI flocking landed; eight-player external playtest; audio spike finished; Wwise selected over FMOD Crash rate above cert threshold; publisher marketing beats not aligned; Drift Belt streaming budget overrun
Week 10 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-15 Cinematic camera rig handed off, localisation pipeline stubbed for 6 languages, and the vertical slice was playable. Crash threshold, marketing beats, and streaming budget remain risky.
Week 9 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-08 First playtest with eight external players; audio middleware chose Wwise over FMOD; grapple cooldown retuned. Crash threshold, subtitle sign-off, marketing alignment, and streaming budget remain risky.
Weeks 5-8 (rolled up) 2026-02-02 to 2026-03-01 Vertical slice, grapple traversal, localisation, and engine/art work advanced across weeks 5-8 Crash threshold, controller tuning, save-game versioning, matchmaking, art remain risky
Weeks 1-4 (rolled up) 2026-01-05 to 2026-02-01 Art direction narrowed, engine upgrade merged, build times improved, and nav-mesh work progressed. Versioning, controller boss tuning, and art delivery remain risky.
